title: Model Catalog Launch Symphony and Communications Timeline
creator: Maya Chen
description: Objective: Coordinate a low-friction, observable launch for three new open models into the Redwood model catalog, ensuring benchmark artifacts, release notes, docs, and comms are synchronized across Engineering, Docs, DEX, Sales, and Growth. This ticket is the cross-functional orchestration manifest — not the model onboarding PR itself. Primary goals: (1) Ensure the model entries pass the catalog readiness checklist (benchmarks, compatibility metadata, quantization notes); (2) Produce a single release bundle (release notes + changelog + public docs + internal playbook); (3) Execute a staged announcement with targeted comms for PLG onboarding and enterprise account reps.
checklist: Engineering: finalize performance benchmark tables and include token-cost baseline per 1k tokens
Engineering: confirm KV-cache compatibility and relevant sequence-length performance caveats
Research: attach eval artifacts with prompt set and regression tests (link to eval harness)
Docs: draft public model page with sample prompts, safety/usage notes, and migration guidance
Console: add per-model telemetry flags and dashboard card for the new model (owner: Console Eng)
Release Notes: write human-facing summary, breaking changes, and recommended routes (hosted/dedicated/private)
Support: prepare FAQ and canned responses for likely tickets
Sales/GTM: create one-pager and email template for enterprise adoption and dedicated migration
DEX: update SDK examples and quickstarts with new model name and parameters
Legal/Security: complete privacy & export checklist and sign-off from Security team
Rollout: schedule canary with 10% traffic then 50% then full — define rollback criteria
acceptance_criteria: Model page published with examples and safety guidance
Benchmarks published and linked in the model metadata
Console telemetry shows baseline latency/cost for canary users
Release notes published and approved by Docs and Legal
Support FAQ available in Zendesk and internal playbook shared
qa_notes: Run full regression set using eval harness before canary
Smoke test sample RP flows for chat + streaming endpoints
Verify SDK examples build and unit tests pass on runtime-1.18 branch
rollout_steps: Day 0: Internal doc & Slack announcement to #product, #eng, #docs, #support
Day 1: Canary 10% for hosted API (monitor latency, error-rate, quality via evals)
Day 3: Expand to 50% if no regressions; Sales outreach to pilot customers
Day 5: Full rollout and public announcement; publish blog + changelog
Post-rollout: 2-week watch window with daily telemetry digest and rollback guard
